properties.hours_note: Office and call center Mon-Fri 8am-4pm. Grocery Pantry scheduling via Call Center Mon-Fri 9am-4pm, twice per calendar month, with curbside pickup, in-person shopping, or free home delivery in Kalamazoo County, per Loaves & Fishes. Call 269-343-3663 before you go.
properties.name: Kalamazoo Loaves & Fishes
properties.note: Largest provider of supplemental food in Kalamazoo County, with a network of pantries and distributions. Senior Commodities Program: people over 60 can receive supplemental groceries at local community centers and residential sites, call to learn how to apply. Mobile Food Initiative: supplemental groceries at sites throughout the county during the month, no pre-registration stated, call for the current schedule. No ID or income verification required, per Loaves & Fishes.

properties.hours_note: Tuesdays 5:30-7pm, per local resource list. Call 269-324-5599 to confirm.
properties.name: Valley Family Church, Grocery Assistance
properties.note: Grocery assistance site listed in a local Kalamazoo resource directory.

properties.hours_note: Tue, Wed, Fri 9am-noon and 1-4pm, per local resource list. Call 269-382-4706 to confirm.
properties.name: Dream Center
properties.note: Groceries, toiletries, and hygiene products, per local resource list.

properties.hours_note: South Michigan Food Bank guide (July 13, 2026) says 1st and 3rd Friday 2:30-5:15pm and 2nd and 4th Saturday 10am-12:45pm. Other directories list different windows, so call 269-532-4912 to confirm before you go.
properties.name: Twelve Baskets Food Pantry

properties.hours_note: 4th Saturday of the month 9am, per food pantry directory. First come, first served. Bring containers for food.
properties.name: Centerpoint Church, Loaves and Fishes Pantry

properties.hours_note: Mon 5:30-7pm (no 5th Monday), Wed 5:45-7pm (not 1st or 5th Wednesday), Thu 1-2:30pm, per directory. Call ahead to confirm.
properties.name: Sunnyside United Methodist Church, Loaves and Fishes Pantry
properties.note: All Kalamazoo County residents eligible for a four-day food supply once every 30 days, per directory. Loaves & Fishes mobile distribution noon-1pm on Nov 7, Nov 21, Dec 5, and Dec 19, 2026: no ID or appointment, does not count toward monthly visits.

properties.hours_note: Tue, Wed, Thu; time of day not stated in the Loaves & Fishes source found. Call 269-343-3663 to confirm.
properties.name: Douglass Pantry, Kalamazoo Loaves & Fishes partner
properties.note: In-person, market-style shopping experience, per Kalamazoo Loaves & Fishes.

properties.hours_note: Mon, Wed, Fri 9am-noon; Tue, Thu 1-4pm, per the South Michigan Food Bank guide and a November 2025 county list. Call 269-344-6119 to confirm.
properties.name: Salvation Army Kalamazoo
properties.note: Food once every 90 days, amount based on household size; walk-ins welcome, per the Salvation Army. Its Loaves & Fishes mobile distribution ended in July 2026.

properties.hours_note: Mon, Wed, Thu 10:30am-12:30pm; Thu 6-8pm, per South Michigan Food Bank guide. An older directory listing says call ahead / by appointment, so call ahead to confirm.

properties.note: Pantry listed in the South Michigan Food Bank Kalamazoo County Resource Guide.

properties.hours_note: 1st and 3rd Saturday, 10am-noon per South Michigan Food Bank guide; the pantry's own site description says 9am-noon, so call ahead to confirm the start time.

properties.name: Milestone Senior Services (senior meals)

metadata.area: Kalamazoo County, Michigan, focused on Kalamazoo, Portage, and Comstock
metadata.name: FreshTrack Kalamazoo, starter dataset
metadata.note: Starter set only, not an exhaustive directory. 14 emergency pantries, 2 soup kitchens, plus senior and mobile programs noted on Kalamazoo Loaves & Fishes and the Salvation Army. Hours come from the South Michigan Food Bank Kalamazoo County Resource Guide, Loaves & Fishes, and local directories checked October 30, 2026, not from a direct call to each site. Schedules change. Call the number in each card before you travel.
